// Consume a function definition, native extern, or source ABI import header.
fn ov_function(reader:*RmdReader)->*RmdDecl {
    var declaration:*RmdDecl = rr_function_header(reader);
    if declaration == null(*RmdDecl) { return declaration; }
    if (*declaration).kind == RMD_D_FUNCTION && rr_take(reader, 59u32) { return declaration; }
    return rr_function_end(reader, declaration);
}

fn ov_read_declaration(reader:*RmdReader, user:*u8)->*RmdDecl {
    if (*reader).token.kind == RR_FN { return ov_function(reader); }
    return null(*RmdDecl);
}

fn ov_read(stage:*OvStage, source:*RmdSource, begin:usize, end:usize)->bool {
    var hooks:RmdReaderHooks = make RmdReaderHooks {
        user:stage as *u8, declaration:ov_read_declaration,
        statement:null(fn(*RmdReader,*u8)->*RmdStmt),
        prefix:null(fn(*RmdReader,*u8)->*RmdExpr),
        type_syntax:null(fn(*RmdReader,*u8)->*RmdTypeSyntax)
    };
    if rr_read((*stage).context, source, begin, end, &hooks) == null(*RmdUnit) {
        (*stage).failed = true;
    }
    return !(*stage).failed;
}
